Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by chembl_id CHEMBL5291721. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows sorted by molecule_chembl_id.
